## Positioning

Billy works between clients, product, and engineering. He runs discovery, translates business requirements into solution designs, explains tradeoffs, and remains involved through implementation, integration, deployment, and troubleshooting.

Primary target roles: Solutions Engineer, Technical Consultant, SAP BTP Consultant, Implementation Engineer.
Secondary target roles: Backend Engineer, Platform Engineer, Full-Stack Engineer.
Languages: Spanish (native), English (B2 professional working proficiency).
